scope: Narrow CSI wire/parser parity and bounded session coexistence/restart/overflow/cancellation gates, not a public stream-lifecycle API or release. Passive MT7925 channel36/20MHz, no TX/ICS/RF-test mode.

commands.initial_python_order: Initial and Python overflow runs precede the --receiver-order flag and used before-filter. The subsequent explicit after-filter run uses the corrected default.
commands.cancellation: Launch each probe as an owned subprocess, send SIGTERM immediately after its unfiltered-window progress record, wait for explicit stop/reload and exit130. Never signal unrelated processes.

qualification.offline: 1914 Python tests, C build/tests and ASan/UBSan pass; source/wheel packaging checked separately
qualification.profile: Version22, band0,20MHz OFDM6,64 signed I/Q pairs; stale CCK count13/storage64, wider/segmented/unknown/truncated reports rejected. No calibration.
qualification.coexistence: Normal RX, matched named-counter/temperature queries and filtered CSI work in both languages with one USB owner.
qualification.new_ordering_result: After START, count1 then ADD emits RX0/1 in both Python/C controls; ADD then count1 produces RX0 only in both. Host filters enforce source/index and reject queued preconfiguration/late-STOP reports.
qualification.overflow: Drop-newest event queues count loss without blocking RX/MCU work. Python before-filter capacity1 run dropped137 events; native after-filter capacity1 run dropped101. Different sequences/traffic, not a sensitivity comparison.
qualification.cancellation: Both probes exited130 with STOP acknowledged and firmware reload alive. Native cancellation exposes11 frames and2 events still queued at destruction; earlier native runs predate this added queue-depth telemetry.
qualification.remaining: Public session-bound ownership/start/accept/stop helpers, per-stage failure/epoch tests, and longer acceptance remain open. No multi-hour/physical unplug/sleep-wake/calibrated CSI claim.
